eligibility.definition: A case is eligible if (1) the Doctor and the Agent have asymmetric information, (2) the Agent has at least one clinically meaningful private evidence item (a physical-examination finding or a test result), and (3) neither the Doctor's nor the Agent's input directly reveals the target diagnosis through its name, its abbreviation or a trivial lexical equivalent.
eligibility.uses: raw case content only; no model output, outcome, trajectory or score

test_composition.note: TEST cases that were TRAIN or DEV of the fixed two-turn run were seen by models of that run. Nothing of that run (labels, predictor, calibration, rubrics, weights, trajectories) is used in the main experiment.

diagnosis_overlap.note: not a leak: different clinical cases. The per-case flag allows a diagnosis-non-overlap subset as a sensitivity analysis.
